nodes.author: shubhvanii
nodes.text: This is indeed concerning. The emergence of new viruses always raises questions about their origins and potential impacts. While it's crucial to focus on containment and treatment, we must also remain vigilant about the broader geopolitical implications. India has shown resilience in handling health crises before, and with proper measures, we can tackle this too. #StayAlert #HealthFirst
